title: Malware Infection on Finance Workstation
root_cause: Root cause traced to: User opened a malicious invoice attachment (ATT&CK stage: Initial Access).

timeline.description: User opened a malicious invoice attachment
Office macro spawned a child process
Mass file encryption detected on mapped network share FIN-SHARE-01

recommended_action: Immediately isolate affected systems and initiate incident containment procedures.
executive_summary: A malware infection was detected affecting endpoint FIN-WKS-07 and endpoint FIN-SHARE-01. The infection chain involved Initial Access -> Execution -> Persistence -> Impact. Immediate containment is underway to limit business disruption.
